[element-long-desc]
=== `<long-desc>` Long Description

Full description or summary of the content of an object such as a graphic, table, figure, or text box.

#### Usage/Remarks
The long description is a non-visual element used by systems such as pronouncing screen readers to make the object accessible to people or systems that cannot read/see/display the object.
#### Long Description Contents

This element was originally designed to _contain_ a description, but some newer systems expect this element to contain a URI that points to such a description. Best Practice is to incorporate a textual description, including or ending with an untagged URI, and repeat the URI in the <<attribute-xlink-href,`@xlink:href`>> attribute so that a link can be made.
#### Accessibility

_Please_ reserve this tag for accessibility uses such as pronouncing screen readers. The <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> is not a visual element; rather, its purpose is to be spoken in circumstances where the visual form of the object cannot be viewed. This element differs from the <<element-alt-text,`<alt-text>`>> element in both length and purpose. The <<element-alt-text,`<alt-text>`>> is typically very short, for quick scan reading by a screen reader or showing as words _behind_ a graphic. The <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> is meant for an extended description of an object such as a figure, table, graphic, etc., for example, a textual summary of a pie chart that explains both the visual form of the chart and significance of its findings.
##### Best Practice

The <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> element should _not_ to be used as a replacement for <<element-caption,`<caption>`>>, which is a visual element typically displayed alongside a figure, table, etc. Thus <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> should not be used to hold supplementary data. The <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> is not a visual element.

#### Related Elements

The similar non-visual element <<element-alt-text,`<alt-text>`>> typically contains a very short phrase. The element <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> either contains or points to an extended description.

#### Tagged Sample

##### Figure description
[source,xml]
....
...
<fig>
 <caption><title>Truth Table</title></caption>
 <alt-text>Truth Table: NOR Gate</alt-text>
 <long-desc>Truth table showing that the output of a NOR gate is zero 
  if any of the input is 1 and the output is 1 only if both the inputs 
  of the gate is 0.</long-desc>
 <graphic xlink:href="flip-flop-NOR-gate.jpg"></graphic>
</fig>
...
....
